motivation: R17.08 and R17.09 daily cross-sectional rotation was too costly/unstable. Test causal 4h breakout and breakdown entry events with low turnover and both directions.
shared: 2023-01-01 to 2026-07-01 exclusive. Signal at end of 4h bar from close above previous N highs for long, below previous N lows for short; next 4h open fill, stop5% target10% priority to stop on simultaneous hits, max 3/7 day hold; taker fee 0.06% and adverse slip 0.04% per side, 4 positions max each up to 25% of marked equity, maximum 1x gross at entry, no duplicate symbol. Median prior 7d 4h quote turnover >=$5m. Funding archived rates with trade-price proxy, skip favorable payment on ambiguous stop bar. BTC trend as prior 30-day 4h mean when enabled. Missing active bars fail.
selection: 2023-2024 return positive and <=20% event-level marked equity drawdown; rank train return then smaller drawdown. 2025/2026 previously viewed, diagnostic only. Compare R17.07 pair_fixed; no live promotion on retrospective data.
limitations: 38-coin preselected cohort, incomplete prior trial registry, no official historical funding mark series or orderbook spread. Even a few +20% months with catastrophic drawdown does not meet goal.
